reason: short answer over the limits after one retry

text: FAA guidance indicates reestablishing the control link is preferred, and if it cannot be reestablished, to initiate emergency or contingency procedures, with actions guided by remote PIC capabilities; if VLOS cannot be regained, pre‑determined procedures should be followed. Autel EVO Max 4N manuals state that signal loss triggers a configured Signal Loss Action after more than 10 seconds, that automatic RTH will try to reconnect, and that during manual flight loss the drone will slow and hover. Incident reports (unverified) claim that shortly after takeoff the control link was lost and the platform continued to fly away, with all Return To Home attempts failing and the UAS not recovered.
